answer: Require every agent identity to lock a copper bond in a shared juniper ledger; the ledger permits only one active claim per audited controller. Random audits compare signed task histories, and linked identities have their bonds merged and any excess stake slashed. A jetty payout gate caps rewards at the amount backed by each bond, so an attacker must immobilize fresh capital for every extra identity yet cannot multiply influence by splitting accounts. The attacker pays opportunity cost while funds are locked and risks losing stake if linkage is found.
